messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error readinf metadata Tags in camera trap images
parts:
The code you posted in the text does not match the code in the screenshot. In the screenshot with the error you use:
metadataSpeciesTag = "Species"
but in the text it is
metadataSpeciesTag = "Species_Id"

According to the metadata of the images the species tag is called "Species_Id", so when you specify it as  "Species" you get the error in the screenshot.

If you get an error with the code in the text above please let us know.
